part: TI BQ28Z610 (gas gauge, low-side coulomb counter)
source: TI BQ28Z610 pin-function table, as applied in vaio_p_modding hardware/tf-battery-board-b8/B8.2-SAFETY-CORRECTION-REVIEW.md (SRP on the cell side of the shunt, SRN on the pack side)

rules.why: SRP's Kelvin filter resistor lands on the cell-side shunt terminal, the IC's VSS reference.
SRN's Kelvin filter resistor lands on the pack-side shunt terminal, not on VSS.
